shapes.text: Team Division: The class will be divided into 2 teams (Team A and Team B).Turn-taking: The two teams will take turns choosing a letter displayed on the screen.Answering: Each chosen letter corresponds to a vocabulary question. The active team must discuss and provide the correct answer.Scoring & Mystery Rewards:If the team answers correctly, they will unlock a mystery reward.The reward points are completely random, so be careful with your choice.Winning Condition: The team with the highest score at the end of the game wins!
